{{Disambig|Mega}}

==Enemies==
'''Mega''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Mega Frost Mystery]], a enemy that spawns random enemies upon death, that first appears on Wave 25 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode
**[[Mega Frost Mystery/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Mega Slow]], a large and tough enemy that first appears on wave 19 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode

'''Mega''' may refer to these event enemies:
*[[Mega Clanker]], a enemy that first appeared on wave 4 in [[Totality Tower|Night IV]]
*[[Mega Ducky]], a high health enemy that first appears as a summoned enemy in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, and appeared on Wave 29 on Easy difficulty and on Wave 25 on Hard difficulty in [[Bathroom Approach]] from the [[Ducky Revenge Event]]
*[[Megatron Toilet]], a high health enemy that first appears as a summoned enemy in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, and appeared on Wave 16 in [[Headache Headquarters]]
